hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Europe, bordering the Adriatic Sea, between Bosnia and Herzegovina and Slovenia || geographically diverse; flat plains along Hungarian border, low mountains and highlands near Adriatic coastline and islands || controls most land routes from Western Europe to the Aegean Sea and Turkish Straits; most Adriatic Sea islands lie off the coast of Croatia -- some 1,200 islands, islets, ridges, and rocks || Resources: oil, some coal, bauxite, low-grade iron ore, calcium, gypsum, natural asphalt, silica, mica, clays, salt, hydropower || Exports: ships, garments, electricity, packaged medicine, wood (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: geographically diverse; flat plains along Hungarian border, low mountains and highlands near Adriatic coastline and islands || Southeastern Europe, bordering the Adriatic Sea, between Bosnia and Herzegovina and Slovenia

climate.excerpt: Mediterranean and continental; continental climate predominant with hot summers and cold winters; mild winters, dry summers along coast || destructive earthquakes

economy.excerpt: upper-middle-income Balkan economy; newest euro user (introduced in 2023); increased investments from EU structural funds and tourism sector contributing to strong but moderating economic growth; declining energy prices and restrictive monetary policy easing inflation; historically low unemployment rate with labor shortages within services and manufacturing sectors || Exports: ships, garments, electricity, packaged medicine, wood (2023) || Industries: chemicals and plastics, machine tools, fabricated metal, electronics, pig iron and rolled steel products, aluminum, paper, wood products, construction materials, textiles, shipbuilding, petroleum and petroleum refining, food and beverages, tourism
